resources.string: Search your Wi-Fi or enter the TV’s IP address. Get your TV ready first, it only takes a minute.
%1$s disappears from the list. You can add it again any time.
No TV with ADB debugging found. Is the TV on and ADB debugging turned on? You can also enter the IP address.
Only TVs that are already in your list.
The phone is not in a Wi-Fi network. Connect it to the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
On the TV, open Settings and find the device info page (often called “About”).
Select the build number seven times until developer options are turned on.
In developer options, turn on ADB debugging (sometimes called network debugging).
Keep the phone and the TV on the same Wi-Fi.
Only do this on your own TV and home network, and turn ADB debugging off again when you don’t need it.
The TV shows its IP address in its settings, usually under Network or About.
That is not an IP address. It looks like four numbers with dots, for example 192.168.0.10.
If the TV asks “Allow USB debugging?”, tick “Always allow from this computer” and choose OK.
The TV answers, but ADB debugging is off. Turn it on in the TV’s developer options.
The TV does not answer. Is it switched on and in the same Wi-Fi as the phone? Check the IP address too.
The TV did not allow the connection. Look at the TV screen: tick “Always allow from this computer”, choose OK and try again.
The connection to the TV broke off. Try again.
Send an APK from your phone to the TV
Remote control, files and more come in the next versions.
When you are done, turn ADB debugging off again on the TV.
Choose an APK file on your phone. Zapio sends it to the TV and installs it there.
Installing on the TV. This can take a minute.
You can leave this screen, the installation keeps running.
%1$s is on the TV now. You find it in the TV’s list of apps.
The file could not be read. Choose it again or pick another one.
This is not a working APK file. It may be broken or incomplete, download it again.
The TV does not have enough free space. Remove apps or files on the TV and try again.
This app is already on the TV, but from a different source. Uninstall it on the TV first.
The TV already has a newer version of this app.
This app needs a newer Android version than the TV has.
This app is too old for the TV’s Android version.
This APK is made for a different processor type. Look for the version for your TV (often called armeabi-v7a or arm64-v8a).
Zapio shows your TVs a key that never leaves this phone. With a new key, every TV asks again whether to allow this phone.
The connection closes and every TV asks again. On the TV you can remove the old permission under developer options, “Revoke USB debugging authorizations”.
Install apps, move files and control your TV from your phone.

Zapio is built with these libraries and fonts. Tap one to read its license.
